title: Scientific review and variability analysis
scope: Identity fit, Iranian applicability, sample depth, laboratory depth, variability and review restrictions for 27 complete profiles.
exit_criterion: Every complete candidate has a transparent R1/R2/R3 decision and independent-review checklist.

title: Ingredient gap closure and ontology expansion
scope: Complete seven partial profiles using SR Legacy/FNDDS; add missing Iranian ingredients and licensed Iran FCT/SAMAR records.
exit_criterion: Core ingredient library is source-complete and all substitutes are explicitly classified.

title: Household portions, edible portions, yield and retention factors
scope: Measured Iranian household units, edible-portion factors, cooking-yield matrix and nutrient-retention library.
exit_criterion: Every recipe ingredient can be converted reproducibly from household measure to cooked edible grams.

title: Standard Iranian recipe canon
scope: Versioned recipes, regional variants, oil/fat scenarios, cooked yield, retention calculation and uncertainty intervals.
exit_criterion: Priority Iranian dishes have reproducible per-100 g and per-serving nutrient profiles.

title: External validation and production release
scope: Independent dietitian/food-composition review, licence audit, reproducibility tests, API/JSON export and mobile projection.
exit_criterion: Signed review, immutable release, documented limitations and validated production export.
